explanation: Uruguay hosted the first men's World Cup in 1930, with every match in Montevideo. The Olympics first went south 26 years later, to Melbourne in 1956.

claims.text: The first Olympic Games held south of the Equator were the 1956 Melbourne Summer Olympics.
The first FIFA World Cup, held in Uruguay in 1930, was south of the Equator.
Every match of the 1930 World Cup was played in Montevideo.
